verdict.rationale: Gusto ships an official, agent-friendly CLI with scriptable commands such as auth, employee and pay-schedule create, which gives it a headless interface for automation. A full OpenAPI spec also backs programmatic use. However, nothing in the evidence documents CI usage, non-interactive or token-based auth for the CLI, or exit codes and machine-readable output. Missing for 10: documented CI/headless mode, non-interactive service credentials for the CLI, machine-readable output/exit-code docs, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Agent-friendly developer interface for Gusto payroll.
